text: U.S. stock indices are trading higher today, led by the technology sector, as investors reacted to a softer-than-expected September jobs report that eased concerns regarding potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. While industrials and consumer cyclicals have also joined the rally, energy and financial services stocks are lagging. The market's positive sentiment is supported by a retreat in Treasury yields following the data, which showed only 29,000 jobs added last month and an uptick in the unemployment rate to 4.2%.
